# `encrypted-rc4-128.pdf` — provenance and passwords

Copied byte for byte from pdfcer's
`fixtures/synthetic/encryption/enc-emptyuser-rc4-128.pdf`. It is a
**synthetic** fixture generated by the pdfcer project for its own encryption
tests; nothing in it is anybody's document.

| | |
|---|---|
| `/V` | 2 |
| `/R` | 3 |
| key length | 128 |
| cipher | RC4 |
| **user password** | empty — it opens without a prompt |
| permissions | all |

## Why this one

The empty user password and full permissions leave RC4 as the only reason
the engine refuses an edit, which is the refusal
`rc4_edits_wait_for_the_operator_and_say_what_they_cost` drives. A `/P`
refusal on the same file would be a different decline.

## Why it was copied rather than referenced in place

`tools/ui-verify`'s checks must run on a clean checkout of this repository. A
check reaching into the pdfcer tree would SKIP wherever the two are checked
out apart, and a skip is not red. `encrypted-aes-128.PROVENANCE.md` carries
the same argument.
